items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Like Rick, Rick got medicine for his.

ctx.x: Yeah, I ain't well not through that anymore. I've been sick all night, Will. Yeah. I got a pay right through the air, look. Yeah. Like a shot, pistol through me. Yeah, you got a... I've been up all night, Will. Yeah, I really love it.
You got medicine that you take for that, though, eh? Huh? Like Rick, Rick got medicine for his. He gets a pain, too.
Look at Rick got his on his left side.
